sources.title: E3SM production simulations
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: NAS NPB：先驗證結果再比較有效執行時間
related.titleEn: NAS NPB: verification gates before timing comparisons
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：只有相同比較範圍且科學通過，候選 SYPD 才有意義。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Candidate SYPD is meaningful only with comparable scope and passed scientific qualification.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「NAS NPB：先驗證結果再比較有效執行時間」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付run-register.csv、驗證原文、可比較群組與排除理由；另外列CPU數、執行緒、編譯器版本與計時邊界，供另一位學徒重新篩選。
related.differenceEn: Investigate NAS NPB: verification gates before timing comparisons using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver a run register, original verification messages, comparable groups and rejection reasons. Include process count, threads, compiler revision and timing boundaries so another learner can rebuild the eligible set independently.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 43200 秒換半天，算五除半；另求每年 8640 秒，再反算每日可完成年數。
建立四筆候選紀錄，保留3秒失敗資料；分開記錄exit code、verification狀態及計時是否完整，避免以單一success布林覆蓋三者。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Convert 43200 seconds to half a day and divide five by that duration. Independently compute 8640 wall seconds per simulated year and invert it to recover throughput, checking units at each step.

Create the four candidate records, including the failed 3-second observation. Record exit status, numerical verification and completeness of the timed interval separately so that one success flag cannot erase their different meanings.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: MLPerf HPC：品質門檻與端到端達標時間
related.titleEn: MLPerf HPC: quality gates and end-to-end time to qualification
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：只有相同比較範圍且科學通過，候選 SYPD 才有意義。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Candidate SYPD is meaningful only with comparable scope and passed scientific qualification.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「MLPerf HPC：品質門檻與端到端達標時間」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付事件表、checkpoint雜湊、品質曲線、split與seed政策；以可重算的第一次達標判定交接，不提供虛構的MLPerf認證分數。
related.differenceEn: Investigate MLPerf HPC: quality gates and end-to-end time to qualification using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver event tables, checkpoint hashes, quality trajectories, validation-split identity and seed policy. Handover a reproducible first-qualification decision without presenting a fabricated certified MLPerf score.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 43200 秒換半天，算五除半；另求每年 8640 秒，再反算每日可完成年數。
畫初始化120、訓練1800、評估60的名義時間線，將0.83綁到最後checkpoint；明列本課把初始化計入，與正式benchmark規則分開。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Convert 43200 seconds to half a day and divide five by that duration. Independently compute 8640 wall seconds per simulated year and invert it to recover throughput, checking units at each step.

Draw the baseline sequence of initialization, training and evaluation and bind the 0.83 quality result to its final checkpoint. Explicitly include initialization under this engineering contract while keeping official benchmark timing rules as a separate review item.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
